01.title: Fall in Q2 2026 transactions on Q2 2025: two publishers, two answers
01.source: Sources: betterhomes Q2 2026 report; JLL as reported by Khaleej Times, 23 July 2026. Definitions not published in full.
01.alt: Grouped bars comparing the year-on-year fall in Q2 2026 transactions by betterhomes and JLL: off-plan 12 and 23.1 per cent, resale 59 and 41.8 per cent, all transactions 31 and 28.6 per cent

02.title: Resale left faster than off-plan: Q2 transactions, year earlier vs Q2 2026
02.source: Source: betterhomes Q2 2026 report. Q2 2025 hatched: our arithmetic from its rounded year-on-year changes (off-plan -12%, resale -59%), to the nearest 100.
02.alt: Stacked bars of Q2 transactions: derived Q2 2025 about 29,900 off-plan and 20,800 resale; Q2 2026 reported 26,338 off-plan and 8,512 resale
